main.description: Progress record for a single step of the Squarespace → Cloudflare transfer workflow. Emitted by sqExporter (steps 1-4) and cfRegistrar (step 5). Sensitive fields (authCode) MUST be signal:v1: encrypted — never plaintext in a federable Repo record.

transferRequestUri.description: AT URI of the parent com.etzhayyim.apps.dns.transferRequest

actorDid.description: Which actor DID executed this step

bindZoneFileUri.description: B2 blob URI for exported BIND zone file (step 4 only)

cfTransferId.description: Cloudflare Registrar API transfer job id (step 5 only)
